response.sql: WITH linked_orders AS (SELECT COALESCE(tr.ordertypedist, 'MISSING') AS mix FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg), mix_aggregates AS (SELECT mix, COUNT(*) AS count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share FROM linked_orders GROUP BY mix), average_calculation AS (SELECT 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_share FROM mix_aggregates) SELECT ma.mix, ma.count, ma.share, ma.share - ac.avg_share AS above_average_distance FROM mix_aggregates ma CROSS JOIN average_calculation ac WHERE ma.share > ac.avg_share ORDER BY ma.share DESC
